notes.title: How to restore your saves
notes.content:
If you lost your save, don't worry. If you didn't started a new game there is a way to restore it.

1. Go to user folder and find .prefs folder.
2. There is a save file called nyctophilia.
3. Open it as a text file.
4. Find a string called "saved" and set its value to "true".
5. Now you can load your save from the game.
